description.value: Birdies is a California-inspired, casually elevated restaurant in Burnaby known for its diverse menu of tacos, handcrafted pizzas, sushi handrolls, and steaks alongside vibrant cocktails. The kitchen clearly labels gluten-aware, plant-based, and vegetarian options throughout the menu, and a provisions fridge stocks ready-made items for take-home. The restaurant features an epic outdoor patio and free on-site parking, making it a convenient stop on Lougheed Highway.

raw_osm.description: Birdies is a laid-back atmosphere with fresh, flavour-driven food and drinks. Enjoy a bowl, salad or one of our signature dishes while sharing a pitcher of margaritas with some friends. Grab something from our provisions fridge to take home.
raw_osm.name: Birdies
